description: Train same direct IQ attention student against frozen source teacher over all eligible source records, no DURA student inference.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Direct IQ multiscale attention network; teacher used to generate source waveform targets only
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test

permissions.query_use: Source L_s labels and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo-targets, paired source IQ, frozen DURA teacher; no U_s truth, V or test.
permissions.claim_scope: Matched seed and source data with preceding attention network; source IDs previously explored, no blind claim.

checkpoint.initialization: Attention restorer initialized exactly as paired original attention; frozen F and source DURA teacher; DURA not called during student inference.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed original Phase1 DURA source checkpoint 47c264286ca689f060a3f36aafb763fe209a6f06; original attention seed and source IDs.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: All eligible 38951 source fit IDs, excluding 8192 prior IDs and source RX4/6/8 heldout cohorts; fixed three source views and eight epochs, final checkpoint; no test-based selection.

dimensions: source training only; no validation scores
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Waveform MSE to frozen DURA source output replaces MSE to clean only; all other CE, feature, identity and per-group training terms remain matched.

rows.purpose: test whether matched source teacher waveform target improves training and receiver transfer
rows.seed_notes: Same model init 2026123054 and order seed 2026123056 as 8192-ID teacher student; more IDs and updates.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Frozen DURA used for source training targets only, absent from student inference.
All 38951 eligible fit IDs, three source views and 8 epochs; prior comparison used 8192 fit IDs, so both data coverage and number of updates increase.
Uses L_s source labels and high-confidence U_s pseudo labels; no U_s truth, V or target.
Formal seven-scene ground test required for this new version regardless of source results.
